design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Water quality “first flush”: treat runoff from 1 inch of rain over the project site (≈90th percentile / first flush), achieving ≥80% TSS reduction or equivalent discharge concentration. Channel protection: match pre-development runoff volume and rate for storms up to the 2-year, 24-hour event (or detain 2-year, 24-hour for 24 hours). Flood control for 100-year as applicable by sewershed.

design_parameters.enrich_notes: Water quality treated as 1 inch (90% annual non-exceedance; 1.00 in Zone 8). Channel protection alternative: extended detention with 24-hour detention period and drawdown not greater than 72 hours. Design infiltration is field rate divided by 2, capped by Table 5 texture classes; soils below 0.24 in/hr design rate unsuitable for infiltration BMPs. Detailed BMP dimensions refer to City Green Infrastructure Standards (Green Book), not in this corpus. Coldwater stream policy: detention times max 12 hours for detention ponds.
